title: Hruday continuum-trajectory statement: the one uniform estimate the fixed-spacing family supplies and the one it fails to supply
accepted: Along the named trajectory (a_n,g_n) -- a hypothesis of asymptotic-freedom form with g_n->0 as a_n->0, not derived -- the fixed-spacing family (uniform Kogut-Susskind SU(2) at fixed spacing, strong bare coupling, as admitted by AX1: every face alpha*tau/24, route B, Haar reference, centered whole-star boxes, cover R={0,e_z}; AL1 dictionary alpha=g^2/(2a), lambda=2/(g^2 a), tau=24 lambda/alpha=96/g^4, so alpha*lambda*a^2=1; E_star and hbar fixed) supplies exactly one uniform estimate, the volume-uniform gap alpha/16=g^2/(32a) for g^4>=9.6x10^9 (0<tau<=10^-8) at fixed a (every finite complete-factor route-B volume and every AQ subsequential state, AX1 gate items (2)-(3), cited; in lattice units a*Delta>=g^2/32>=1250 sqrt 6, directed lower end 19595917942265424785578272597647131/6400000000000000000000000000000, about 3061.86), and fails to supply any estimate uniform along a_n->0 on a trajectory with g_n->0 (the admitted regime is left at a finite index and the AL1 bridge g^4>=32, i.e. tau<=3, fails from a finite index on; on the toy trajectory g_n=g_0/n the first indices below 9.6x10^9 and below 32 are n*=2 and n*=132 for g_0^4=9.6x10^9 and n*=4 and n*=421 for g_0=1000; common rescaling a->a/s at fixed g moves no admission ratio; a finite physical gap along a_n->0 needs a_n*Delta_n->0, impossible inside the admitted regime; this is failure of a sufficient certificate, not a statement that the gap closes); this is not a statement that the continuum limit exists, that any estimate is uniform in a, that the coupling is weak, or that any fraction of the continuum problem is thereby resolved.
limitations: Only the uniform Kogut-Susskind SU(2) model at fixed spacing and strong bare coupling (g^4>=9.6x10^9, |tau|<=10^-8) as admitted by AX1, with the AL1 dictionary; the supplied gap is volume-uniform at fixed a and never uniform in a along a trajectory with g_n->0

The trajectory is a hypothesis of asymptotic-freedom form, not derived; no beta function is computed or used; the toy trajectory g_n=g_0/n (a_n=a_0/n declared) is algebraic and not of asymptotic-freedom form; physical-units numbers are illustrations without scale setting
Failure of a sufficient certificate only: nothing is said about the actual gap where the certificate stops; the route radii 7/274688 and 1/20416 are not admitted regimes

The continuum requirements (uniform-in-a estimates, reconstruction hypotheses, physical scale control) are missing, as are the AY2 state obligations and nontriviality; no loop count is a fraction of the continuum problem
Inherited without re-proof: the AX1 gap (AM2 contraction, cutoff removal, AQ passage), the AL1 dictionary and bridge, the I1 geometry
The Faizal-Shabir construction (arXiv:2606.19362) is an unaudited lead read at abstract depth by the modern lens; neither producer nor skeptic read it; nothing depends on it
Single producer, correlated model agents; the premises print the headline; the agreement is a replay of elementary algebra
model: Uniform Kogut-Susskind SU(2) at fixed spacing and strong bare coupling (AX1 route B; every face coefficient alpha*tau/24; dictionary alpha=g^2/(2a), lambda=2/(g^2 a), tau=96/g^4; admitted regime |tau|<=10^-8, i.e. g^4>=9.6x10^9 at fixed a); a named trajectory (a_n,g_n) with g_n->0 stated as a hypothesis of asymptotic-freedom form; toy trajectory g_n=g_0/n, a_n=a_0/n; E_star fixed; statement loop with one forward producer and the skeptic's independent derivation and replays
decision: Admit the AZ1 statement: (1) the dictionary identities alpha/16=g^2/(32a), tau=96/g^4 and alpha*lambda*a^2=1 (and eight derived identities) verified exactly as rational-function identities and on a 35-point grid; the cap g^4=9600000000 at tau=10^-8; (2) the one necessary uniform estimate the family supplies is the volume-uniform gap alpha/16=g^2/(32a) at fixed a for g^4>=9.6x10^9 (AX1 gate, cited not re-derived), uniform in N and never in a; on every trajectory with g_n->0 the admitted regime is left after finitely many steps (the AM2 contraction is admitted only for tau<=10^-8; the AL1 bridge condition g^4>=32 also fails from a finite index on); the admitted regime cannot host a finite-mass limit (a*Delta>=g^2/32>=1250*sqrt(6), about 3061.86, directed); (3) toy trajectory crossovers exact: with g_0^4=9.6x10^9, n*=2 for the cap and n*=132 for the bridge (131^4<3x10^8<132^4); with g_0=1000, n*=4 and n*=421; no rigorous construction of an asymptotic-freedom trajectory satisfying either bound uniformly was found in any sub-round's source search, and the claimed construction of Faizal and Shabir (arXiv:2606.19362) is disclosed as an unaudited lead only; (4) the AL1 bridge obstruction and the failure of common rescaling (tau invariant under a-rescaling; r invariant under joint alpha,lambda rescaling) retained; what a continuum construction would additionally require (uniform-in-a estimates, reconstruction hypotheses, physical scale control) listed with the missing premise for each; no number here is a fraction of the continuum problem. Gate fields: continuum_claim false, uniform_in_a_claimed false, weak_coupling_claim false, loop_count_fraction_claimed false, uniform_in_N_claimed true with scope 'volume-uniform at fixed a, strong bare coupling'. No sub-label applies (sub_label null). Recorded non-blocking: the producer's wording defects D1-D9 (the mandatory sentence contains the negated forbidden phrase and is excluded from the scan; 'exactly one uniform estimate' read as 'exactly one necessary estimate'; 10^-8 is the admitted cap, not a sharp threshold; common rescaling derived from AL1 since AL2 is not a premise; the toy trajectory's a_n declared as a_0/n; negative tau is the U_E mirror; state_provenance wording), the skeptic's N1-N12 (the scan also strips code spans; literal phrase scan; four unscoped negated sentences, wording only; the AX1 gate hash not pinned in check.py), the panel arithmetic slip in modern update-4 (10^12/81 remainder 28, not 34; no index affected), post-freeze name exposure of untracked files disclosed by both. Commit order: skeptic pre-comparison 649db92 before producer 8359876. Nothing about the continuum, weak coupling or a uniform-in-a estimate is admitted. Select AZ2 next (already frozen and in production).
